tweets.text:
This will be interesting to watch.

In 2022, Bitcoin bottomed 176 days after its longest weekly losing streak, with another 46% decline.

If the current streak ends this week and a similar timeline unfolds, that would put the bottom around late May 2027.

quote.text:
Bitcoin printed 7 red weekly candles in a row.

> From $86,510 to $61,170
> -29% in 7 weeks
> The second-longest weekly losing streak since 2013

The only longer one was 2022: 9 red weeks, -37%, ending May 29, 2022.

What came after that streak:

> 1 month later: -32%
> 3 months: -31%
> 6 months: -44%
> 12 months: -6%

The bottom came on Nov 21, 2022, 46% below the end of the streak and 176 days later. Bitcoin did not close back above the level where that streak started until January 2024.

A long losing streak did not mark the low last time.

This week's candle closes Sunday. A red close would make it 8.

$ETH Has been pretty uneventful relative to $BTC during 2026.

We've seen some short periods of out and underperformance but no major trend has been formed.

Above, 0.03 ETH/BTC would be risk on and would bode well for alts relative to BTC.

Otherwise I assume this keeps chopping sideways like it has been doing. Market obviously very risk off right now and not a good environment for alts as a whole. Need Bitcoin to bottom clearly first before ALT/BTC pairs start doing better.

$BTC: Bulls vs Bears is a 1:1 draw so far. At 60k the bears called for 40k and got 87k instead. At 87k the bulls were sure the bull run was on and got 57k instead. I was one of those bulls. I bought at 60k, rode it to 87k and didn't see the crash coming. But nobody has won this yet. We're right back at the summer lows where the whole pump started. The bears are still waiting for their 40k and the bulls are still waiting for their bull run. Until the final move comes, it's a furious price action between the two, and my money is on the bulls.

I've shared my levels many times since July, when I first called 57k the bottom and set my buy region at 60-64k. Now that BTC has tagged 55k, I'm widening it to a 10k range. Be like water. 52-62k is my spot buy region and I'm buying a piece from cash every day as long as price sits at any price between 52-62k. My short-term long from 80k stays open as well. I see this as a great long-term opportunity and I'll keep adding.

tweets.text:
The high timeframe $BTC chart got a lot of work to do.

This current low is a key area to hold before testing the ~$50K area from the 2024 summer lows.

Above, the Weekly 200MA/EMA & Bull market support band are all located around the $70K area. These will start moving down but before we see a weekly close above those, bearish sentiment and momentum will be in charge.

Generally it takes some time before this is all digested and done.
